description: Replace the n=32/64/128 scalar paths with one persistent matrix-queue superkernel using 16x16 blocked POTRF, warp-group tensor-core trailing updates, vectorized triangular I/O, and shape-specific FP32 repair. Pack multiple independent matrices per CTA or cluster to remove per-pivot barriers and scheduling tails while preserving every larger-shape dispatch, caller ordering, and fresh-input correctness.

Unified persistent 16x16 blocked POTRF superkernel for n=32/64/128; packed 4/2/1 matrices per 512-thread CTA, compensated TF32 WMMA rank-k updates, vectorized triangular I/O, static persistent matrix queue. Validation and fresh-input guard passed; small-shape times 40.886/47.454/58.658 us; full-grid geomean regressed from 781.913 to 854.755 us.

Packed 8 n=32 matrices with 64-thread groups and 4 n=64 matrices with 128-thread groups per CTA; solve teams stride across rows. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small shapes improved from 40.886/47.454/58.658 to 30.489/37.088/55.173 us; full-grid improved from 854.755 to 807.724 us, versus 781.913 baseline.

Packed 16 n=32 warp groups, 8 n=64 two-warp groups, and 2 n=128 eight-warp groups per 512-thread CTA using all named barriers. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small shapes measured 29.397/36.593/58.006 us (baseline 16.346/21.211/56.234); full grid 804.380 us, improving 807.724 but remaining above 781.913.

Separated matrix-group density from CTA size: 256-thread CTAs for n=32/64, warp sync for 32-thread groups, occupancy-aware persistent grid, restored one 512-thread n=128 group. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small shapes 29.424/36.273/54.816 us; full grid 800.061 us versus 781.913 baseline.

For n=32/64, kept one TF32 WMMA high-product update and replaced the second compensated MMA with per-element FP32 quantization-residual repair; n=128 unchanged. Validation/fresh-input guard passed with scaled residuals 0.025/0.016, but small-shape latency regressed to 40.301/73.082/54.796 us and full grid to 916.598 us. Hosted profile at fifth-trial cadence was requested and denied because all three rolling-hour slots were allocated; no hosted request was sent.

Removed TF32 high-product and residual pass for n=32/64, using a single exact FP32 blocked rank-k update; n=128 retained compensated WMMA. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small shapes measured 36.613/60.741/54.756 us; full grid 841.389 us. A second hosted index-0 request was denied due run-wide slot allocation; no hosted request sent.

Restored compensated TF32 WMMA for all small shapes and applied templated launch bounds targeting 3 resident 256-thread CTAs for n=32/64 and 2 resident 512-thread CTAs for n=128. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Register constraint worsened n=32 to 32.748 us, n=64 was 36.879, n=128 55.707; noisy full grid 833.807 us.

Isolation control restored parent scalar n=32/64 launches while retaining the persistent n=128 implementation and all larger dispatches. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small cells returned to 16.383/21.233 us and n=128 measured 55.280 us; full grid reached a new run best 756.698 us versus 781.913 baseline. Manager notified immediately to submit exact commit.

Removed failed launch-bounds constraint from persistent n=128 while retaining proven scalar n=32/64 controls. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Cells measured 16.315/21.182/54.464 us, improving the n=128 donor from 55.280; full grid 762.538 us was dominated by a noisy batch8/n2048 mean and did not beat fa33d374's 756.698.

Profile-guided interleaving of two independent n=32 factorizations per warp (8 matrices per 4-warp CTA) targeted 42.7% no-eligible scheduler cycles in fa33d374's hosted NCU capture. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. n=32 regressed from 16.315 to 18.807 us, while n=64/n=128 held at 21.287/54.754; full grid measured a brief-best 750.968 us from unrelated favorable cells, still above run best 748.014.

Packed eight independent one-matrix n=32 warps in each 256-thread CTA while preserving the profiled 48-register algorithm. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. n=32 regressed from 16.315 to 17.916 us (better than dual-interleave 18.807), n=64/n=128 were 21.242/54.689; full grid 750.957 us, statistically tied with prior 750.968 and above run best 748.014.

Measured 11 variants. The all-shape persistent 16x16 blocked design improved from 854.755 to 800.061 us as packing moved 4/2/1 -> 8/4/1 -> 16/8/2 and then 256-thread CTAs, but its best targeted cells remained about 29.4/36.3/54.8 us versus the current-run scalar-control 16.3/21.2/56.2. TF32-high plus FP32 residual repair measured 916.598; direct FP32 blocked rank-k 841.389; forced launch bounds 833.807. Restoring scalar n32/n64 while retaining persistent n128 produced fa33d374 at 756.698 us; exact index-0 hosted NCU job 6e1f7233 is archived under profiles/2026-07-20-23-00-46-cholesky-unmerged and showed 48 regs/thread, 16.9 KiB smem, no spills, 34.1% achieved occupancy, and 42.7% no-eligible scheduler cycles. Removing n128 launch bounds produced the strongest causal small-shape donor 9fe33936 with 16.315/21.182/54.464 us. Profile-guided two-matrix warp interleaving and eight-warp CTA packing raised n32 to 18.807 and 17.916 us; their full-grid scores 750.968/750.957 were favorable noise and remained above run best 748.014. Keep the work going with true SM100 tcgen05/warp-group asynchronous MMA across several matrices, lower-register tensor operand staging, a warp-only two-row n64 factor that removes cross-warp pivot barriers, or a cluster/global queue variant; those structural variants were not reached by the WMMA implementation measured here.
